kimaṅga tasya bhūrlokaḥ kathametāni cāṅgāni kathaṃ vāsontare tasya iti
prastutapraśnatrayottaropodghātatvena varṇitaṃ śuddhe brahmaṇi
jagadadhyāropaprakāraṃ punaḥ kramaśastātparyataśca samyagjijñāsamāno rāmastatra
tātparyataḥ svajñātāṃśaṃ darśayituṃ siṃhāvalokananyāyena vyavahitoktaniṣkarṣaṃ
smārayati - bandhetyādina

ataḥ asau sarvasākṣiṇī buddhireva viṣayamārjane kimapi
vāṅmanasāgamyamādyaṃ brahmeti tvayā tātparygatyā upadiṣṭam

sthūlasya bhūtabhautikasya sūkṣmabhūteṣu nāśe bhūtasūkṣmaiḥ saha
avyākṛtānupraveśe
anyāpekṣayā śūnyaṃ paramasūkṣmaṃ sadapyākāśaṃ yadapekṣayā sthūlam

tathā anyāpekṣayā sthūlaṃ viśālatamamapi brahmāṇḍaṃ yadapekṣayā
sūkṣmataramaṇutaram

māyāvaraṇāntaḥsuṣuptaprāyaścidākāśaḥ svapnonmukha iva
svāntarlīnajagatsaṃskārarūpāṃ paramāṇutāṃ vetti paryālocayatīva
tathā ca śrutiḥ tapasā cīyate brahma iti

nanvekatra dṛśyadraṣṭṭabhāvo viruddhaḥ kathaṃ saṃpadyate iti
cetsvapnavadvirodhāparyālocanādityāha - yatheti
tathā kalpane'pi na vāstavaikyakṣatirityāha - tata iti

dṛśyamiva draṣṭeva ca dvitāṃ tadā
udeti udvahati

sa ca draṣṭā māyābalena prakāśasvabhāvamaṇuṃ paricchinnamātmānaṃ
paśyansaṃstadanubhāvata ucchūnatāmupacayaṃ cetayate kalpayati

tadaiva tasya tannāntarīyakatayā deśakālādivibhagakalpanā api bhavanti paraṃtu tā
vāgādyabhivyaktyabhāvādanuditābhidhā ityāha - deśeti

tadaiva tripuṭīvibhājakopādhibhedānāṃ sākṣiṇastadālokananimittabhāvasya ca kalpanā
bhavatītyāha - upalabdhamiti

evameva kartā kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhoktā bhogyaṃ bhoga ityāditripuṭībhedānāṃ
tatsākṣiṇastannimittatāyāśca kalpanaṃ sarvatra bodhyamityāśayenāha - evamiti

eteṣāṃ śrotrādipañcakaviṣayāṇāṃ
prathamaṃ prāktanaṃ yannāmavarjitaṃ svarūpaṃ tattanmātramiti śabdo yasya
tathāvidhaṃ yatastadetadākāśarūpi sūkṣmatamamityarthaḥ

evaṃ krameṇa cidaṇoḥ pratibhalakṣaṇa ākāśa eva ghanasthitiḥ san piṇḍaḥ sthūladeho
bhavati tatra rūpādyanusaṃdhānavaśādindriyapañcakaṃ cetatītyupasaṃhāraḥ

dṛśyeṣu śabdādiṣu
punaḥpunaranubhavātpoṣamupacayamupaiti tatrendriyagṛhītaviṣayāṇāṃ
smṛtidaśāyāṃ jñānaṃ cittamiti adhyavasāyadaśāyāṃ buddhiriti cābhidhīyate

tataḥ saṃkalpavikalpadaśāyāṃ mano'bhimānenāhaṃmamatayā tadārūḍhaṃ
tadabhiniviṣṭaṃ sat ahaṃkārapadaṃ gatam

tatra kāle deśe ca pūrvavatkalpanā uttarakālakalpanāmapekṣyaiva pravartata ityāha -
cidaṇoriti
asya prasiddhasya bhāvasya śabdādiviṣayasya pratyagraṃ navam

yatra deśarūpe kālarūpe vā ādhāre vedanaṃ yasya cidaṇorjīvasya bhavati sa
cidaṇustasya deśakālasya cottarakālena vyāvartyena nimittena pūrvaṃ ityabhikhyāṃ nāma
kariṣyati kalpayiṣyatīti pratijīvaṃ prativastu cedamaniyatameveti bhāvaḥ
tāṃ kalpanāmapekṣya ūrdhvābhikhyāṃ tato'nyasminkāle ekāmeva kariṣyati

diśi
tūrdhvadakṣiṇapaścimādyabhidhānāni bahūnīti viśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ

evaṃ deśakālavastubhedāṃstannāmāni ca kalpayitvā gṛhītasaṃketānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ
śabdaśravaṇe tattadarthavedanātmanāpi svayameva saṃpatsyata ityāha - deśeti

evaṃ svayameva prathamamātivāhikadehastato
deśakālakriyāvastuvibhāgastatastattannāmabheda iti krameṇa nāmāntaṃ
sarvajagaccharīraṃ saṃpadyata ityarthaḥ

sa gaganākṛtiścidaṇuḥ svadehe'pi kalpanīye vakṣyamāṇaprapañcāṃ
saṃkalpanāmupādatte
īśvarāṇāmapi dehādikalpanā saṃkalpavaśādeva kiṃ punaranyeṣāmityāha - evamiti
vyaṣṭivatsamaṣṭyātmā virāḍapyevameva kalpanayotthita ityāha - pratikanda iti

yathā svapne abdhīnāṃ meghānāṃ saṃgrāmāṇāṃ siṃhānāṃ ca
garjābhirmahādhvanibhiścorjitātmanāpi suptanareṇa vastuto maunavatā niḥśabdameva
sthitaṃ tathā tenāpi virājā niṣprapañce svarūpe sthitamityarthaḥ

svapnasaṃdṛṣṭānāṃ yoddhṝṇāmārabhaṭī kolāhalastadvedanaṃ jāgrataḥ
smṛtipathaṃ gataṃ sadyathā nātyantāsannāpi sattathā prapañco'yaṃ sthitaḥ
dhānakā vaṭabījādayastāvanmātramapi kulāyaṃ nīḍacchidraṃ na pūrayati

aṇumātraṃ tejaḥ paramasūkṣmā cit prathamaṃ
cetitvāccittavapuḥ saṃpannam

sa eva cittātmā varṇitakrameṇa sphārasaṃvittiḥ san
mahānbrahmāṇḍātmaivāhamiti sthita iti saṃgraha ityarthaḥ

ata eva tadīyāḥ prāṇā vātaskandhāstadupasaṃhāreṇa
vātaskandhabhaṅgo'smābhirvarṇita ityāśayenāha - spandeti

spandasaṃvedanāttena prāṇaspanda ityanubhūyate iti yaduktaṃ tatsarvānubhavaprasiddhyā
samarthayati - prāṇeti
paricchākalpitā dehāḥ kathametasya vyaṣṭitāṃ gatāstatrāha - praticchandyāditi

yadyasmāddhetostathāvidhādasmādutthitāḥ pratipuruṣadehaṃ tattadvāsanāmayā
brahmāṇḍā evameva bodhyā ityāha - dehā iti

tatraikabījāntarantaryathā vṛkṣabījaparamparā krameṇodbhavadarśanādastīti
saṃbhāvyate tadvadatrāpi saṃbhāvyatāmityabhipretyāha - citiriti

ata evānye'pi grahā ṛkṣagaṇā
nakṣatrasamūhāśca prāṇena yadā ṣṭhīvanaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ tatsīkarāḥ śleṣmavindava
ityarthaḥ

tasya śiraḥ ūrdhvakapālaṃ pādau
adhaḥkapālaṃ tvacaṃ brahmāṇḍāvaraṇāni ca vayaṃ dūrasthatvānna paśyāmaḥ

tacca saṃkalparūpasya kalpanātmanaḥ
kalpanāmātraṃ na bāhyasādhanasādhyaṃ na ca manaḥkalpanātmakaṃ kiṃcidvāstavaṃ
saṃbhavati
